svg.aria-label: What I can build. 1. AI infrastructure & agents: Ingestion and retrieval pipelines, MCP servers, model routing backed by evals, and streaming agents. Shipped: Bytebell · Clarity · chat-agent-backend. Tools: MCP, OpenRouter, Neo4j, Redis, Claude, DeepSeek, Pinecone. 2. Backend & data systems: APIs, queues and workers, relational and graph schemas, and time-series models, all measured before and after. Shipped: Router rewards (~1,200 DAU) · Palladium · Bytebell. Tools: NestJS, Node.js, Hono, Fastify, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ. 3. Full-stack product: Complete web apps from interface to database: swap flows, dashboards, internal tools and PWAs. Shipped: Router Nitro swap · freelance clients · Impact AI Sessions. Tools: Next.js, React, Vue, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Supabase. 4. Data pipelines & automation: Scrapers and ingestion jobs that run on a schedule, validate their own output and fail safe. Shipped: Spinneret · Palladium · Clarity. Tools: GitHub Actions, Puppeteer, Playwright, Docker, Neon, Drizzle, Vercel. 5. Web3 & cross-chain: Bridges, wallet SDKs, smart contracts and on-chain payments across EVM, Solana, NEAR and more. Shipped: Router Nitro (30+ chains) · Tangled SDK (8 ecosystems) · Meme Duels. Tools: Solidity, Ethereum, Solana, NEAR, Hardhat, ethers.js, Chainlink. 6. Developer tools & DevRel: Browser and VS Code extensions, npm packages and CLIs, plus the docs and workshops that onboard developers. Shipped: safe-deploy · Terms Simplified · ScanLens · ThirdFi (1,000+ devs). Tools: Chrome Extensions, VS Code API, npm, Postman, Swagger, GitBook.
